$ cat .config/nextest.toml
[profile.default.junit]
path = "repo-owned.xml"
$ cat lydite.toml   # what lydite stages and passes as --tool-config-file lydite:<path>
[profile.default.junit]
path = "junit.xml"

[profile.rerun.junit]
path = "junit-rerun.xml"
$ cargo nextest run --tool-config-file "lydite:<cache>/lydite.toml"
